main_body: Wooden shelf/counter front in the middle (rows 7-17) with three recessed cubbies holding goods, framed by a plank band above (rows 0-5) and another below (rows 19-24)
top_band: Only a 1-2 row light-brown rim at rows 7-8 along the top of the middle body; no real horizontal surface. The plank bands at the top and bottom are separate vertical planks.
evidence: Reading down the middle column, there is a thin 1-2 row lighter rim, then straight into the front face with cubbies and goods. The cubby openings are inset, but the top is a rim that is too thin to read as a surface. The whole piece reads as a flat front view like the red 'front elevation' and 'rim only' guide shapes. There is no foreshortened top band and no eave shadow.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 brown steps with dithered grain and speckle, and the outlines are dark brown rather than black. The items in the cubbies add a few accent colours. It has fewer ramp steps and less per-tile detail than the stall reference, but it is not a flat sticker and sits acceptably next to it.
